definitions: Extinct large cats of the subfamily Machairodontinae, characterized by elongated, knife-like canine teeth.
Any of various extinct predatory mammals noted for their long, curved canine teeth.
examples: Saber-toothed tigers roamed the Earth during the Pleistocene epoch.
Fossils of saber-toothed tigers provide insights into prehistoric ecosystems.
The museum exhibit featured a skeleton of a saber-toothed tiger.
